Data extraction: .properties flat key=value pairs (closes issue #136)

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"data_extraction\":true,\"language\":\"properties\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("host=localhost\nport=8080\n", config)
    println(result.data)
    println(result.data?.kind)
    println(result.data?.children)
}
```
